adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the constructed `evt: CalendarEvent` (around the shown block building `evt`) does not include any `team` field or team member data—only `organizer`, `attendees`, etc. However, `sendAddGuestsEmails` in `email-manager.ts` explicitly checks `if (calendarEvent.team?.members)` before emailing additional organizer/team members. From the diff alone, nothing populates `evt.team`, so that branch will never run and only the initial organizer email (`new OrganizerAddGuestsEmail({ calEvent: calendarEvent })`) is sent. This makes team-member/host notifications for team bookings effectively non-functional in the new feature.
